title: Practice 1: Verbs that take the dative

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.prompt: I trust your ability to know what to do instinctively.
exercises.why: «верить» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«отвечать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Следуй ___ (веления) своего сердца, оно никогда не обманет.
exercises.prompt: Follow your heart, for it never lies.
exercises.why: «следовать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«верить» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«противоречить» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Everyone has a desire to be liked, It's perfectly natural.

«следовать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: В дебюте ходите только те пешки, которые помогают ___ (фигуры) развиваться.
exercises.prompt: In the opening, move only those pawns that help develop the pieces.
exercises.why: «помогать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
«аплодировать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.prompt: The hyena imitates the human voice.
exercises.why: «подражать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Observers note that animals don't conform to human labels.
exercises.ru: Наблюдатели отмечают, что животные не соответствуют ___.
exercises.why: «соответствовать» takes the dative. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
